name: 06 - US VIRAL | YouTube Publisher

nodes.name: Pick for YouTube
nodes.notes: 0 items = nothing to upload this run.

parameters.text: ={{ '▶️ Short su YouTube (' + $('Pick for YouTube').item.json.privacy + ')\n' + $('Pick for YouTube').item.json.title.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') + '\nhttps://youtube.com/shorts/' + $('Upload Short').item.json.uploadId }}

nodes.name: Save YouTube Error
nodes.notes: yt_error set: the post is not retried automatically (clear it to retry).

parameters.text: ={{ '❌ Upload YouTube fallito\n' + $('Pick for YouTube').item.json.title.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') + '\n' + String($('Upload Short').item.json.error?.message ?? $('Upload Short').item.json.error ?? '').slice(0, 300).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') }}

parameters.content:
## US VIRAL YouTube Publisher
12:20, 16:20, 20:20 New York (1h after the Instagram slots): uploads the oldest Reel already published on Instagram (last 48h) as a YouTube Short.
viral_config: yt_enabled, yt_max_per_day, yt_privacy, yt_category_id, yt_force_post_key (test).

description: US VIRAL YouTube Publisher: 1h after each Instagram slot uploads the oldest Reel already published on Instagram as a YouTube Short (yt_enabled, yt_max_per_day, yt_privacy, yt_force_post_key for tests).
